study measuring a range of times spent in REM sleep and the number of words in the participant’s
dream narrative.

Some participants were upset at debriefing because they had not helped other players.
Describe the ethical guideline of protection, using this study as an example.

text: In a study about helping, participants were told the study was about visual tracking. They played
a computer game in which they could help other players. They were given fake eye-movement
tracking spectacles to wear.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:

study in a laboratory.

than a chimpanzee for this study.
